metadata.description: Claude Code mods that show your work items, tasks and sessions, for any tracker.

plugins.name: handily
plugins.description: Every handily mod in one install, and /handily to show which mods are installed and loaded.

plugins.name: handily-board
plugins.description: A board with two tabs: this session shows the task list that Claude and you share, and this machine shows every local session, the ones that wait for you first. /board opens it, and four model tools keep the list.

plugins.name: handily-item-toasts
plugins.description: A toast when a work item changes outside this session, at most one every 30 s.

plugins.name: handily-quiet-items
plugins.description: One short row in place of each tracker write in the transcript.

plugins.name: handily-reply-view
plugins.description: Long replies fold to their first lines, tables draw without box lines, each table and code block gets a copy button, and each prompt you type opens under a coloured rule labelled you.

plugins.name: handily-simple-view
plugins.description: One short row for each Bash, Edit, Write, Read, Grep and Glob call, with buttons to open and copy its output, /simple to switch it and /simple show to print a call in full.

plugins.name: handily-workitems
plugins.description: Provider of one typed work item list over any tracker, for other handily mods.
